### Advent Meditation: The Blessing of Believing
Author: Betsy Childs Howard
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/blessing-believing/
Passage: Luke 1:45
Points:
- Mary trusted God's message even though she faced overwhelming uncertainties regarding how the conception and her future would unfold.
- True biblical faith does not require understanding how God will accomplish His purposes before choosing to believe Him.
- Christians are called to rely on God's promises of provision, guidance, and justice without knowing the exact outcome in advance.
- God already knows the answers to all our questions and has a sovereign plan to fulfill every promise He makes.

### Regeneration Is Immediate
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/regeneration-immediate
Passage: Luke 1:41
Points:
- The immediacy of regeneration means the Holy Spirit changes the human heart directly rather than through secondary human agents.
- John the Baptist leaping in Elizabeth's womb upon Mary's arrival illustrates God's sovereign, direct work upon an unborn child.
- While people hear the gospel through external preaching, they cannot respond until the Holy Spirit quickens their dead hearts.
- Just as one cannot be partially pregnant, there is a distinct dividing line between being regenerate and unregenerate.
- Unlike regeneration, sanctification is a progressive work in which God actively uses ordinary means such as prayer and Scripture.
